We need the confirmation and credit estimate ahead of our monthly billing run on Mar 10. Billing contact is billing@acme.com.

Subject: [Internal] INC-1147: node failure -> autoscaler delay -> elevated 5xx/latency

Internal summary (TL;DR):
We confirmed an infrastructure incident that resulted in a degraded serving capacity for a subset of hosts in us-east-1. Sequence: a multi-GPU node experienced a crash during routine memory compaction at ~2026-03-01T22:27:40Z. The autoscaler erroneously failed to provision replacement capacity for ~38 minutes due to a throttle bug in the placement controller (root cause identified).

Observed customer-facing impact (from our edge logs): elevated 5xx and 95/99p latency spikes beginning 2026-03-01T22:28:05Z and subsiding by 2026-03-01T23:06:12Z. Total degraded window ~38 minutes.

Incident ID: INC-1147
Artifacts attached: incident-log-INC-1147.txt (stack traces + controller events), preliminary slo-window-calc.csv (internal SLO overlap calculation).

Initial credit eligibility check: based on the above window and the contract SLO (99.95%), it looks likely the account will meet the threshold for a partial monthly credit. Final calculation requires matching Acme's observed timestamps and an official overlap calculation (we'll share the spreadsheet).

Next steps (internal):
- Karthik/Marissa: communicate preliminary confirmation and collect any additional evidence from Acme.
- Laura: loop in Finance to prepare a credit memo draft and confirm invoice timing.
- SRE: finish RCA draft and propose customer postmortem (target 72 hours).

Vivek
SRE Lead, Redwood Inference

Attachments: incident-log-INC-1147.txt, slo-window-calc.csv
